title: Ghazi Diyan Baawan Lay Gaiyan
body:
Jaira Zaamin Paak Ridaawan Da, Oh Veer Toh Ho Qurbaan Geya
<<DIVIDER>>
Is Khabar Ne Seena Cheer Ditta, Abbas Ne Mur Ke Aaona Nai
Raitan Wich Baazu Rul Jaanay, Kissay Laash Nu Vi Dafnaona Nai
Bethi Khaak Te Zainab Rondi Ay, Kitthay Pardeyan Da Nigraan Geya
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhiyan Wich Tapdiyan Raitan Sarn, Zakhmaan Chon Khoon Vi Jaari Si
Ghazi De Sikh De Hotaan Te, Zainab Di Parda Dari Si
Jadon Laash Chawarn Pyu Jaaye Di, Kul Sabiraan Da Sultan Geya
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas Di Maut Te Lokaan Ne, Sehra Wich Jashan Manaaye Ne
Zahra De Laal De Sajde Wich, Teeran Ne Kitte Saaye Ne
Jiddi Aas Te Bhaina Baahr Aaiyan, Oh Maut Da Ban Mehmaan Geya
<<DIVIDER>>
Tin Nokaan Wala Teer Jadon, Asghar De Gal Te Maareya Si
Masoom Sakina Ro Ro Ke, Chachay Ghazi Nu Pukareya Si
Do Ghut Paani De Waaste Hy, Ay Jhoola Ho Viraan Geya
